fixer.title: agentHost: preserve rebound backends during provisional cleanup (#343…

introducer.title: agentHost: sync workspace folders for existing sessions

cases.mechanism: Each workspace-folder change fanned out over all tracked sessions; every rebound session whose desired roots changed could schedule one agent-host createSession and one disposal of its previous backend.
cases.symptom: Workspace changes could cause avoidable per-started-session host I/O, provider initialization, and teardown latency.
cases.fixedBehavior: The added ownership guard skips rebound, non-owning entries during workspace-root reconciliation, preventing their backend recreation and disposal while preserving the existing behavior for owned untitled drafts.
cases.evidence: In the base revision, the workspace-folder listener skipped only disposed entries, so rebound started sessions reached _reconcileWorkspaceRootSet. A changed root set then reached _reconcileGeneration, which calls IAgentHostService.createSession and disposes the prior generation across the agent-host protocol. Node-side creation initializes a provider and touches database/filesystem state; disposal performs database, provider, and storage cleanup. Added tests verify that workspace-folder changes now produce zero create and disposal calls for rebound sessions.
